title: Bucs owner Joel Glazer will gladly write a big check for Baker Mayfield's next contract

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bucs owner Joel Glazer will gladly write a big check for Baker Mayfield's next contract
sources.description: Buccaneers owner Joel Glazer will gladly pay what it takes to keep quarterback Baker Mayfield in Tampa Bay beyond the 2026 season.
